'''''Star Wars: Yoda''''' is a [[canon]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] miniseries by [[Marvel Comics]] that was written by [[Cavan Scott]], [[Jody Houser]], and [[Marc Guggenheim]], and illustrated by [[Nico Leon]], [[Luke Ross]], and [[Alessandro Miracolo]]. The [[Yoda 1|first issue]] was published on [[November 23]], [[2022]] and the series concluded with its [[Yoda 10|tenth issue]] in [[August 2]], [[2023]].
